source: Joint Advisory Group on GI Endoscopy (JAG), participating services register
rule: One row on JAG's participating services register is one endoscopy SERVICE, not one trust. A trust running several services can hold several different statuses, so a trust's entry below carries its services and a count of each status it holds, never a single badge for the organisation. Every status is JAG's own word, read at https://app.thejag.org.uk/RegisteredUnits.aspx on the read date; the register has no feed and no publication date, so that date is the only date there is. Organisation names join to data/trust-map.json (NHS ODS) by exact match after normalising case, apostrophes and '&', plus two named expansions recorded under aliases. Nothing is fuzzy matched: an organisation that does not join is listed under unmatched with its services. A trust absent from the register is absent from JAG's list on the read date, which is a statement about the list and not about the trust.
